insurer_name: Star Secure Health Insurance Co. Ltd.

clauses.text: The Company shall indemnify Medical Expenses incurred for Hospitalisation of the Insured Person during the Policy Period, provided the Insured Person is admitted as an in-patient for a minimum continuous period of 24 hours, up to the Sum Insured opted.

Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses shall be limited to 1% of the Sum Insured per day, subject to a maximum of Rs. 7,500 per day. Expenses incurred in a room category above the eligible limit shall be pro-rated as per the terms of proportionate deduction.
Expenses for Cataract surgery (per eye) shall be limited to 25% of the Sum Insured or Rs. 40,000, whichever is lower, per eye, per Policy Year.

Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded, except claims arising from an Accident, provided the same are covered under the Policy.

Expenses related to the treatment of the following conditions shall be excluded until 24 months of continuous coverage has elapsed since the inception of the first Policy: Hernia, Cataract, Benign Prostatic Hypertrophy, Hysterectomy for menorrhagia or fibromyoma, Joint Replacement due to Degenerative Disease, and Fistula/Fissure in Ano.

Expenses related to maternity treatment, including normal delivery, caesarean section and complications of pregnancy, shall be covered only after the Insured Person has completed 36 months of continuous coverage under this Policy or any preceding Policy with the Company, subject to sub-limits specified in the Policy Schedule.
Any Pre-Existing Disease, and its direct complications, shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage from the first Policy inception date with the Company.

Expenses incurred for dental treatment or surgery, and any cosmetic or plastic surgery or treatment to change appearance, are excluded unless necessitated due to an Accident or as part of a Medically Necessary Treatment forming part of a covered illness, and requiring Hospitalisation.
Expenses incurred on road ambulance transportation of the Insured Person to a Hospital in case of an Emergency shall be covered up to Rs. 2,000 per Hospitalisation.

Medical Expenses incurred during the 30 days immediately preceding the date of Hospitalisation, for the same illness or injury for which the Hospitalisation claim is admissible, shall be covered as Pre-Hospitalisation expenses.

Medical Expenses incurred during the 60 days immediately following the date of discharge from Hospital, for the same illness or injury for which the Hospitalisation claim is admissible, shall be covered as Post-Hospitalisation expenses.

A Co-payment of 10% shall apply on all admissible claim amounts for Insured Persons aged 61 years and above at the time of Hospitalisation. No Co-payment shall apply to Insured Persons below this age.
